run_aggregate_scores_mean: run aggregate_scores.py to compute the mean of repeated quality estimation scores from an input file
run_aggregate_scores_std: run aggregate_scores.py with the std function to compute standard deviation of repeated scores
run_aggregate_scores_median: run aggregate_scores.py with the median function to aggregate repeated scores by median value
run_aggregate_scores_min_max: run aggregate_scores.py with min or max function to find extreme values across repeated scores
run_aggregate_scores_output_file: run aggregate_scores.py to write aggregated quality estimation scores to a specified output file
